best_hook.why: Groom at the altar tells his bride 'I cannot marry you, Juliana' - the whole premise in one line, no context needed.

best_cliffhanger.why: After being told to leave with dignity, a defiant smile breaks through her tears: 'Dignity?' - the comeback is coming but not yet delivered.

must_promos.why: Sister mocks the jilted bride ('kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding'), stepmother and groom pile on, and it cuts the instant Juliana turns defiant.
Groom rejects her as too plain for a 'better choice', she begs her father, and he coldly sides with the groom - ends on total family abandonment.

standalone_risk: The older woman is only an off-screen voice and the father is labeled a blond nobleman, so a stranger may not grasp who is family; her closing speech is a payoff that needs the jilting already understood.
notes: Second half of the episode resolves into a triumphant speech, so the best cut ends before it.
